Prevention: Conservation of natural pest enemies of whiteflies such as ladybird beetles, small birds, spiders, lacewings, hoverflies, ground beetles, mirid bugs and damsel fly.
Plant border crop with red gram/cow pea/black gram to increase natural enemies.
Grow trap crop of castor or chrysanthemum around the field for attracting towards the trap crop throughout the growing period.
Collection and destruction of adult whiteflies.
Whiteflies are strongly attracted to the colour yellow, so avoid wearing yellow clothing around whiteflies or else you may carry them from plant to plant.
Avoid using a lot of nitrogen fertilizer, including manures.
P & Mg fertilizer according to fertilizer recommendation guide published by
Monitoring: Setup light traps at a rate of 1 per acre from planting and observe during 6 to 8 pm.
At the beginning of the season, hang sticky yellow traps above the plants to provide early detection of an invasion
Direct Control: Neem oil at a rate of 30 ml in 1 litre of water at 15-day intervals.
Spray soap water (1 tablespoon of liquid soap per 4 litres of water).
Restrictions: When using a pesticide or botanical, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label, such as dosage, timing of application, pre-harvest interval, max number of sprays, restricted re-entry interval.
Do not empty into drains and water sources.
SL at a rate of 2.5 ml /10
